summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gained the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members from the spec and an Enum import; botocore/args.py gained compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator, the EPRBuiltins import, and an absent-endpoint-config guard in _should_set_global_sts_endpoint; tests/unit/test_args.py gained TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: all 59 tests in tests/unit/test_args.py pass. test_client.py and test_regions.py pass. One test in test_session.py (test_internal_component) fails, and it also fails on the untouched tree, so it is pre-existing. black and flake8 are not in the shared venv, so lint was checked by hand (no added line over 79 columns). Nothing was committed. The FIPS and DualStack values come from the bridge's private methods _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint, since no public lookup exists.
